text_block_list.text:
"On our way back from our outing, Mejiro Palmer said
she wanted to drop by somewhere, so we went to a cafe."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Takes me back, this cafe.
Truth is, I used to come here a lot as a kid—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, it's Rice! Yahoo!
Did you come here to hang out?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
H-Hello!
Um, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
This shop looks just like the setting of my favorite picture book.
It's so fun, like I'm inside the book itself.
Especially around the big bookshelves... it's identical.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: A huge bookshelf...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Could that picture book happen to be
'The Fairy's Cafe'?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
T-That's true, but...
Why would Palmer-san—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Come to think of it,
Palmer-san's mother is...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
My mom is actually the author of that picture book.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah. Remember how I said I used to come to this shop when I was little?
I used to come here with my mom, you know—

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Look, Mama!
There's a book way up high~!
I wonder how we get it down!

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Oh!
Maybe the fairies will get it for us?

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Waah~! What kind of fairy!?
Can I be friends with them too?

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm sure they wear glasses.
And with those glasses, they can see right through to your feelings.
That's why you'll surely become true friends~.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wah...! That's incredible, absolutely incredible!
To think that was Palmer's idea!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? N-No way!
I was just standing by your side.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It was always like that—
Mama would take casual things I said,
flesh them out, and turn them into picture books.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
That's why I had so much fun talking to Mom.
I used to follow her around everywhere~.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah... Th-Then are there other stories that came to be like that?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, yeah!
I'm pretty sure back when we went to the park as a family, too—

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wooww,
that tulip is super tall!

text_block_list.name: Palmer's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Must be a princess dressed in full regalia.
Does that mean this is the land of flowers?

text_block_list.name: Young Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It's a dance ball with flowers and dresses!
Mama, let's dance together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
It felt kinda like that, I guess.
When I'm with Mama, it feels like we're adventuring through all kinds of different worlds, and it's so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, you see! Rice thought so too.
The author of 'The Fairy's Cafe'...
Palmer-san's mother's picture books are all—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I read it, it makes me feel like this
world really exists somewhere, and it's so thrilling...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "So, um... thank you so much for introducing me to such a wonderful world!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you for the wonderful words.
I'll be sure to pass them on to Mama too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Man, who would've thought Rice was a fan of mom?
Talk about right under our noses, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. Knowing Mom's picture books are helping someone...
makes me really happy, as her daughter."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I've been watching Mom work hard this whole time, after all.
choice_data_list: You can't afford to lose either.
You can't afford to lose either

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"Truth is, y'know? Apparently Mom
wants to write a picture book with me as the model."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I wanna help Mom out, but
I'm telling you, just wait a sec.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's going to be in Mama's picture book, you know?
That special book that turns someone's world into something sparkling and bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Then... I don't want to leave just yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I have to do even better in my races.
I need to work hard enough to match Mom's efforts.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Waaaay! The abso-lute best!!
...I wanna run once I feel like my true self!
choice_data_list: When that happens, sign my picture book, okay!
When that happens, make sure to sign my picture book!
This could make a lovely picture book.
This could make a lovely picture book, don't you think?

text_block_list.text:

...I wanna run once I feel like my true self!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, if I'm gonna be in a picture book,
of course my Trainer's gonna be in it too, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to telling my story,
Trainer, you're an irreplaceable part of it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
So Trainer, that means you'll be signing too!
Let's do our best together when the time comes~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I'll make it... a wonderful picture book!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I gotta call Mom and tell her too.
Along with Rice's thoughts, I'll share all this spirit!

Listening to her talk so happily was truly heartwarming.
I'll look forward to the day her picture book comes out.
